description: Test suite for the bot.helpers module functions, including buildFeishuAgentBody, toMessageResourceType, resolveBroadcastAgents, and buildBroadcastSessionKey. Uses Vitest testing framework to verify behavior of these functions with various inputs.

methods.name: buildFeishuAgentBody
methods.description: Constructs a message body object including message ID, sender name, quoted content, mentions, and permission error messages based on provided context and error info.

methods.name: toMessageResourceType
methods.description: Maps a resource type string to its corresponding message resource type used in Feishu.

methods.name: resolveBroadcastAgents
methods.description: Resolves and returns the list of agents for a broadcast peer ID based on configuration, or null if not applicable.

methods.name: buildBroadcastSessionKey
methods.description: Replaces the agent ID prefix in a session key with a new agent ID, handling compound peer IDs.
